items.name: Anibal
items.tagline: A voice assistant that runs on your own rig
items.description: Talk to the models you serve, hands-free. Say the wake word or hold a key, ask anything, and Anibal answers out loud, using the server you pick here. Speech recognition and the voice run on this machine.
highlights: Answers out loud with a local voice
Uses whichever server you pick in PXA Control
Nothing leaves your network unless you allow it

permissions.why: To send your question to the model you picked

permissions.why: To show what it heard when the sound is off

permissions.label: This machine only

items.name: Ask your documents
items.tagline: Point it at a folder and chat with what is inside
items.description: Indexes the PDFs, notes and text files in a folder you choose and lets the Chat tab answer from them, with the passages it used.

permissions.label: Reads the folder you choose and keeps a search index next to the Control settings

items.name: Discord relay
items.tagline: Let your Discord server chat with your models
items.description: A bot you invite to your own Discord server. Members talk to the model you choose; you set who may use it and how much.

permissions.label: Relays messages between your Discord server and one model you pick

items.name: PXQN quants
items.tagline: The supporter tier: the same size as PXQ, much lower error
items.description: Every PXQN file on huggingface.co/poisonxa as a one-click download, and the Pro encoder's PXQN tiers in the Encode tab. PXQ files and the Free encoder stay free for everyone.
highlights: New PXQN releases while it is active

items.name: Overdrive presets
items.tagline: Measured launch settings for V100 and P100 rigs
items.description: The settings behind the board numbers, as Launch presets: card split, context, KV type and the levers that measured faster on each card type.

items.name: Long-context presets
items.description: Launch presets that trade a little speed for a much longer context on 16 and 32 GB cards.

items.name: Long history
items.tagline: Keep 90 days of Live charts instead of 30
items.description: The Live tab keeps minute-level history for 90 days, so a slow week can be compared with a fast one.

items.name: Early builds
items.tagline: Try engine builds before they ship
items.description: Opt in to the pre-release engine channel in the update check. You can go back to the stable build at any time.
